summary: ioneer Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a quarterly activities report. The report describes an equity raise of approximately US$50 million (A$72 million) via 400 million shares at A$0.18 (~US$0.13) per share, a strategic partnering process with Goldman Sachs, and a court decision upholding the Rhyolite Ridge permit. While the filing includes capital markets activity and strategic discussions, it does not constitute a definitive special situation—it is a routine quarterly update by a foreign private issuer. No merger, tender, or activist campaign is announced; the equity raise is ordinary-course financing. The filing does not meet criteria for any special-situation category.
